programmes.d: McCall finds her loyalties sharply divided when an important murder case being prosecuted by the Assistant District Attorney, with whom she is in love, is jeopardized by Hunter.
Mysterious tape recordings accusing a company of illegally dumping toxic waste seem like a prank until Hunter and McCall find that someone is willing to kill to conceal the truth.
When Hunter confronts the police department to defend the actions of a Chinese-American policewoman critically wounded in the line of duty, the pair heads to Chinatown.
Tony's up for the NYPD commissioner job while dealing with a habitual drunken driver, a jail hunger strike and two missing cops — found underwater.
A damsel in distress sees Tony as her shining knight, causing distress in his castle; Stan fixes tickets for a fetching neighbor.
Tony butts heads with both a tough cop who is overzealous in his handling of criminals and a hard-nosed management consultant hired by the city in a cost-cutting effort.
In the aftermath of the Steelgrave case, Vinnie tries to vindicate himself of his lingering feelings of betrayal by risking his life to save an old friend.
Vinnie's assignment to check out a contract killer leads him into a huge global contraband syndicate.
Vinnie gets his first trial by fire when Mel Profitt disrupts the wedding of an associate, who retaliates by kidnapping Susan.
Hunter and McCall try to solve a bank robbery and murder while coping with the double and triple-crossing schemes of a criminal who once saved Hunter's life.
When the husband of a policewoman is murdered, evidence of wife abuse makes Hunter and McCall suspect the woman's patrol partner who knew about the beatings.
A veteran police dispatcher is blackmailed into undermining Hunter's and McCall's investigation of a multimillion-dollar gold robbery when her son is kidnapped.
Tony is stymied when identical twins both initially confess to the same murder, then, in a surprise about-face, accuse each other of the crime.
A serial killer has been mutilating the bodies of Eastbridge transients and homeless people — and Tony begins to suspect the perpetrator's identity.
During the holiday season, Tony investigates the murder of an elderly woman allegedly killed in her home during a Christmas burglary.
Vinnie tells Mel Profitt he is leaving to New Jersey, but Mel offers him the biggest cocaine distribution network in the country.
When Mel's former girlfriend shows up, begging for readmission to the inner circle, he uses her as a sexual pawn in a power game with a rival.
Vinnie retrieves secret records that enable Mel to blackmail a French official into buying munitions.
A beautiful San Francisco police detective aids Hunter and McCall in solving a series of puzzling murders apparently connected to the estate of a deceased millionaire.
Hunter and McCall search for a vengeful woman suspected of murdering two men involved in her sister's cocaine-related death.
Hunter and McCall try to protect their informant, Sporty James, from his own greed after he blackmails a ruthless cocaine dealer who's responsible for a murder.
